plan_summary: Navigate to the box stack, pick the topmost box (BOX_TOP), navigate to TEMP_TABLE and place it there temporarily, then navigate back to the stack, pick the now-exposed BOX_MIDDLE, navigate to INSPECTION_TABLE and place it there, then pick the temporarily placed BOX_TOP and place it back on the remaining BOX_BOTTOM to restore the lower stack.
assumptions: The robot starts at its current position and can navigate to all named locations.
The BOX_TOP is the only reachable object initially because it is on top and can be picked.
TEMP_TABLE is a safe temporary location to place BOX_TOP.
After picking BOX_TOP, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the new top of the remaining stack (on BOX_BOTTOM) and is graspable.
The INSPECTION_TABLE is at (-2.2, 2.0) and the TEMP_TABLE is at (-2.2, -1.8).
